meta.name: PFL MMA
meta.description:
PFL brings the sport-season format to MMA, where every fight matters on the path to the PFL World Championship and $1 million title prize. Catch up on the greatest fights, highlights, and commentary from MMA's league with PFL on Pluto TV.

Shows: Best of PFL, PFL in 60, PFL Lineage, Full Fights: Justin Gaethje, Gym Tour Series
Available on: Pluto TV
